en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm riverside or lakeshore with several wooden rowboats pulled up along a stone-edged bank. A few people sit in one of the boats. In the background are wooden houses and sheds with pitched roofs, partially obscured by birch trees and a picket fence running along a dirt road. The layout and printing style look early‑20th‑century. The word "Joensuu" is printed in the upper left, with a handwritten code above it.
